$tags.added: home in the main navigation (by collection or title rule)

$tags.unassigned: no collection in Intercom, written to Drafts > Unassigned
$tags.unmapped: a collection no group claims, written to Drafts > Unassigned
$tags.published / draft: Intercom state; drafts of added articles live under drafts/
$tags.placed-by-title: placed by a title rule rather than its collection
$tags.video: video-only, moved to the nearest Videos group
$tags.not-written: no page: empty in Intercom, did not convert, or could not be written
$tags.has-issues: something went wrong or is left to fix; see the article's `issues`

$issues.fetch failed: Intercom did not return the article body
$issues.empty body: the article has no body in Intercom
$issues.conversion error / body did not convert: the HTML could not be turned into a page
$issues.write failed: the .mdx file could not be saved
$issues.image download failed: the image was not saved (e.g. HTTP 404); the page links Intercom's URL, which may expire
$issues.image over 20 MB / image over 5 MB: Mintlify rejects 20 MB; 5 MB is slow
$issues.remote image: the page shows an image straight from another site
$issues.link to oloid.help: links to an article that was not migrated
$issues.dead anchor: an Intercom #h_ link that leads nowhere
$issues.raw html: an HTML tag the converter left in the page
$issues.h1 in body: a second page title inside the body
$issues.image glued to text: a screenshot on the same line as text
$issues.generic alt text: an image whose alt text says nothing
$issues.empty link text: a link with no words to click
$issues.html entity: a literal   or similar in the text
$issues.frontmatter / page missing: the page file is malformed or gone
